Branch Tracking

A feature in version control systems that allows a local branch to be associated with a remote branch, enabling seamless synchronization, updates, and monitoring of integration status.

Definition

A feature in version control systems that allows a local branch to be associated with a remote branch, enabling seamless synchronization, updates, and monitoring of integration status.

Operational example

Branch tracking enables automatic synchronization between a developer's local branch and the upstream remote branch in collaborative workflows.
